name: reality-corpus-1
revised: 2026-10-27, before any reader was scored: cond-02's trigger corrected from bell to always (the wind is a condition and the bell tower only a place); two reason ids renamed to generic codes (unknown_trigger, unknown_place); rules written down. After the first scoring: comp-12 relabelled partial (not_here): Redbank has no wolves, so 'draw wolves' cannot happen there; the reader offers the rest and names it (a product decision: readings must build in their village).
author: written by the developer (Claude) for phase 04; the same author wrote the reader, so this measures regressions and honesty, not unbiased accuracy

labels.supported: every meaningful part can be represented; the reading must contain these target kinds, operators and trigger events
labels.partial: some parts can be represented and the rest must be named as omitted (absent lists the concept)
labels.ambiguous: two materially different readings exist; the reader should offer a choice, not pick silently
labels.unsupported: nothing executable should come out; the reader must say why (absent lists the concept)

rules: A reading matches a supported or partial case when its target kinds, operators and trigger events include the listed ones (extra ones are allowed).
Lanterns or smoke fires named as the place something is near must be burning: they also power the clause. A bell tower named as a place does not ring.
The moon and stars named as a time mean night; 'clear night', 'cloudless' or 'not raining' mean clear_night.

'absent' lists the reason a reader must name: an ABSENT concept id (time, the_dead, metal, shadow, sky_bodies, monsters, minds, sea, tools, game) or a reason code (no_change, no_mechanic, abstract, contradiction, incompatible, transform, infinite_resource, absolute, unbounded_spawn, animals_not_modelled, unknown_trigger, unknown_place, single_instance, exact_count, fraction, third_clause, instruction, not_here).
